question_cn: 为避免被燕尾杀，以下哪种做法最有效？
question_en: What is the most effective way to avoid a dovetail mate?

options.text_en: Advance the king toward the center of the board

options.text_cn: 在王的斜向逃格旁放置己方棋子，增加保护
options.text_en: Place friendly pieces near the king's diagonal escape squares for protection

options.text_cn: 确保王的斜向逃格不被己方棋子占据，保留对角线逃路
options.text_en: Keep the king's diagonal escape squares free of your own pieces

options.text_cn: 换掉对方的后，消除威胁
options.text_en: Trade off the opponent's queen to remove the threat

explanation_cn: 燕尾杀依赖己方棋子封死王的斜向逃格。只要保证王的斜向逃格不被己方棋子堵住，黑后就无法完成燕尾杀。将己方棋子放在逃格旁保护反而可能堵死逃路，要注意区分。
explanation_en: Dovetail mate depends on the king's own pieces blocking its diagonal escape squares. Keep those squares unoccupied by friendly pieces so the queen cannot complete the pattern. Be careful: placing defenders beside the king may block its escape instead.
